company.name: Superpowered AI
company.shortDescription: Superpowered AI offers API for retrieval augmented generation to connect LLMs to data and get accurate responses with citations.
company.description: Superpowered AI provides an API for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). This end-to-end solution allows developers to build advanced LLM-based applications.
company.headquarters: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

productsAndServices.description: An API that connects large language models (LLMs) to your data, providing accurate responses with citations.
productsAndServices.name: API for Retrieval Augmented Generation

productsAndServices.description: A set of proprietary technologies designed to overcome common failure modes in standard RAG pipelines.
productsAndServices.name: SuperStack

productsAndServices.description: A tool that converts poorly posed user inputs into well-formed search queries to enhance retrieval performance.
productsAndServices.name: AutoQuery

productsAndServices.description: A feature that dynamically retrieves relevant information by allowing variable length context to be provided to the LLM.
productsAndServices.name: Relevant Segment Extraction

productsAndServices.description: A tool that automatically injects descriptive document-level context into text chunks and embeddings.
productsAndServices.name: AutoContext

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows users to create a knowledge base from local files or URLs, supporting various file types including audio files.
productsAndServices.name: Knowledge Base Creation
